title: Kickoff: define baseline + target reduction for Dedicated provision-to-ready automation
creator: Vanessa Ortiz
project: Provision-to-ready automation sprint (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
description:
Context
We are kicking off the Provision-to-ready automation sprint for Dedicated GPU capacity bring-up. Today, Dedicated pool creation/expansion has multiple manual handoffs (Terraform apply, image selection, cluster bootstrap, helm/runtime config, control-plane registration, readiness checks) with inconsistent criteria for when a pool is actually safe to route.

This kickoff issue defines:
- Baseline measurement (current time-to-ready and why it’s slow)
- Target reduction + stage budgets
- Scope boundaries (what is/ isn’t in this sprint)
- Initial work breakdown + owners
- Definition of “Ready” vs “Provisioned” aligned with Platform/Routing + SRE

Links
- Confluence overview (stages/owners/pain points): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGINFRA/Provision-to-ready+automation+overview
- SLO proposal (readiness): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGSRE/Dedicated+capacity+readiness+SLO
- Time-to-ready metrics & alerting: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ENGSRE/Time-to-ready+metrics+and+alerting
- Drive baseline analysis doc (working): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ri-time-to-ready-baseline
- Drive stage timing sheet (working): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ri-time-to-ready-stage-timings

Goals
1) Establish a credible baseline for Dedicated “time-to-ready” across the last ~10 bring-ups/expansions.
2) Set a concrete target reduction (overall + per-stage budgets) that SRE/Infra/Platform agree is meaningful and achievable.
3) Align semantics:
   - Provisioned: infra exists + reachable (but not necessarily safe/validated)
   - Ready: passed readiness gates + control plane state transition + routing allowed to advertise/consume capacity
4) Produce a work breakdown that maps the sprint work to pipeline stages and closes the top delay causes.

Non-goals / out of scope (explicit)
- Rewriting the serving runtime.
- Changing procurement/vendor contracting timelines.
- Building a full customer self-serve UI for provisioning (operator CLI is OK).

Baseline: what we will measure (definition)
Metric: time_to_ready
- Start timestamp: provisioning run created (Requested → Provisioning) OR operator-trigger time (we will standardize to “run created”).
- End timestamp: control plane marks pool Ready AND routing integration confirms pool eligible for advertisement (Ready gating enabled).
- Unit: hours, tracked as p50/p95 by region + GPU SKU + pool type (new pool vs expansion).

Secondary metrics
- Stage duration histograms: Provisioning, Imaging, Bootstrapping, Validating, Perf-canary
- Failure rate per stage (hard fail vs retryable)
- Retry counts per run and top error categories
- “Stuck stage” timeouts (p95 > threshold)

Data sources
- Current: Terraform apply logs, helm install logs, control-plane registration logs, ad-hoc operator notes.
- Sprint deliverable: structured provisioning events with correlation_id (ENG-2748) + backfill for baseline (ENG-2756).

Initial (rough) baseline hypothesis (to be validated)
From operator anecdotes (pre-baseline):
- End-to-end: typically 24–72 hours calendar time for a new Dedicated pool in a busy region, driven by:
  - Terraform/IAM/quota iteration loops
  - Imaging delays (artifact mirror / long pulls)
  - Bootstrap misconfig + unclear error surfacing
  - Manual readiness checks + perf validation not standardized

Target (proposed) after automation pilot
Proposed target for the pilot cohort (internal pools + 1 customer expansion):
- p50 time_to_ready <= 8 hours
- p95 time_to_ready <= 16 hours
- Automation success rate >= 90% (run reaches Ready without human intervention)
- Clear manual override/break-glass path with audit logging for the remaining cases

Stage budgets (draft for alignment)
- Provisioning (IaC + base infra): p50 1.5h / p95 3h
- Imaging (golden image pull/boot): p50 1.0h / p95 2.5h
- Bootstrapping (k8s + helm/runtime bootstrap): p50 1.0h / p95 2.0h
- Validating (smokes: net/DNS/TLS + GPU health + runtime smoke): p50 0.5h / p95 1.0h
- Perf-canary readiness suite: p50 0.5h / p95 1.0h

Open questions to resolve in week 1
1) Start time definition: do we start the clock at “request approved” or “run created”? (Proposed: run created, because approvals vary.)
2) What counts as “Ready” for routing? Decision needed from Platform/Routing: Validating is NOT usable; only Ready is routable.
3) How do we treat customer-driven maintenance windows (where time-to-ready includes intentional waiting)? Proposal: tag runs with “blocked_external_window=true” and exclude from core SLO.
4) Are we measuring new pools and expansions separately? Proposal: yes, label by run_type.

Initial work breakdown (mapped to sprint tickets)
- State machine + control plane semantics
  - ENG-2742: provisioning state machine (Requested → Provisioning → Imaging → Bootstrapping → Validating → Ready/Failed)
  - ENG-2759: SLA/semantics for Ready marking + routing consumption

- IaC orchestration
  - ENG-2743: Terraform orchestration wrapper (idempotency/retries)

- Golden images + promotion
  - ENG-2744: image pipeline (pinned drivers/runtime prereqs)

- Config schema + validation policy gates
  - ENG-2745: JSON schema + lint/policy checks + break-glass override

- Readiness gates + perf validation
  - ENG-2746: readiness gates (GPU health, net/DNS/TLS, runtime smoke)
  - ENG-2747: perf-canary integration for readiness thresholds

- Metrics, events, dashboards
  - ENG-2748: stage timing metrics + structured events + correlation IDs
  - ENG-2749: dashboard and alerts for stuck stages/failures
  - ENG-2756: backfill historical time-to-ready metrics (baseline)

- Operator UX + controls
  - ENG-2750: operator CLI trigger + rerun stages (dry-run)
  - ENG-2751: pause/resume manual override + audit logging

Acceptance criteria (for this kickoff ticket)
- Baseline plan written down and agreed in #eng-infra (what runs, what timestamps, what exclusions).
- Target p50/p95 + stage budgets proposed and reviewed by Infra (Vanessa/Irene), SRE (Rafael/Aisha), Platform (Ethan/Ravi).
- Scope boundaries explicitly documented, including non-goals.
- Sub-issues created (or confirmed) and mapped to the pipeline stages above.
- Links added to the Confluence overview and baseline working docs.
